## Overview
A clear and concise summary of what changes this PR introduces.

## Related Issues
Closes #(issue) or Relates to #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Refactor / Code cleanliness
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI/CD or Build system change

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] Backend tests pass (`go test ./...`).
- [ ] Static analysis passes (`go vet ./...`).
- [ ] Frontend builds and typechecks without errors (`bun run typecheck`).
- [ ] Any necessary documentation changes have been made.
